name: Stable Audio
tagline: Generative AI for music and sound effects from a text prompt.
description: Stability AI's text-to-audio tool: describe a track or sound effect and it generates studio-quality stereo audio, with structured full-length songs in later versions. A web studio plus a generation API on the Stability platform. Subscriptions add longer outputs, more monthly generations, and commercial licensing.

modelSupport.notes: Ships Stability AI's own audio-diffusion models.

edge: Trained on AudioSparx-licensed music, pitched as commercially clean — unlike rivals trained on scraped audio now facing lawsuits.
